component: Graph folder deletion and native listener completion

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original bridge detaches a task that batches folder IDs and compares successful response count to choose a legacy fallback. Accepted source later takes one ID and awaits a single typed deletion before reporting no fallback. The native hard-delete listener removes the local folder on success, while soft delete uses the Trash copy path. The bridge return only starts asynchronous work. Preserve these phases and the later signature change; no callback or deletion ran.
title: Graph folder deletion has separate task-start, remote-operation and local-removal phases
